inner_cv: GroupKFold(n_splits=3, groups=subject_id) on each outer-training set
shared_encoder_selection: classification inner Macro-F1 primary; regression heads tune only their own parameter after encoder selection
outer_test_rule: outer-test may be used once only after all encoder and head decisions are finalized; never select dimension, levels, k, temperature, alpha, preprocessing, or codebook parameters
candidate_failure_rule: a candidate failure fails the current fold; never silently skip
checkpoint_rule: save independent checkpoint per outer fold when modeling is authorized
